reply.emotion: warm and bright, smiling while speaking of a good moment
notes: Feliz is used for general happiness as well as feeling pleased with a specific situation.

senses.definition: Que siente felicidad, alegría o placer.

examples.text: Ella está muy feliz con su nuevo trabajo.
examples.translation: She is very happy with her new job.
examples.emotion: proud and cheerful, sharing good news with a smile

senses.definition: Que se considera favorable o afortunado.

examples.text: Tuvimos un viaje feliz sin ningún retraso.
examples.translation: We had a fortunate trip without any delay.
examples.emotion: relieved and satisfied, looking back at a smooth journey

definitions: Que siente felicidad, alegría o placer.
Que se considera favorable o afortunado.
